integrity: The Gaussian pseudoinverse inverse-Wishart moment used is classical; newly assessed results are the two-sided tangent-normal loss law, Haar finite-population factor, sharp sketch thresholds and realized-sketch norm. No independent validation or complete bibliography certificate.
scientific_limitations: Instantaneous real finite-dimensional oblique tangent projection with fixed independent sketches; no trajectory stability or computational-runtime claim, no structured or complex sketches.
title: Exact Gaussian–Haar normal-leakage laws for oblique low-rank tangent projections
